data.one_liner: Shows a remotely controlled force update prompt for iOS and Android apps.
data.what_it_does: Fetches a required app version from a remote source (like Firebase Remote Config or a custom backend) and compares it with the current app version. If the required version is greater, it prompts the user to update and navigates them to the store listing.
use_when: You need to force users to update their app versions using a remote configuration.
You want a UI-agnostic package that only tells you when to show the update prompt.
avoid_when: You need web or desktop platform support for force updates.
You want a solution that automatically queries app store APIs directly instead of a remote server.
strengths: Remote-controlled logic independent of store API quirks.
UI-agnostic, allowing full customization of the update alert dialog.
weaknesses: Requires managing a remote endpoint or remote config source for the required version.
data.setup_notes: Add ForceUpdateWidget to MaterialApp's builder property and supply an iOS App Store ID if deploying to iOS.
